baseline_models.mechanism: Measured creation is followed by an assigned social form: peoples branch apart, yet the same root also carries mending, while tribes are mutually facing groups and recognition reads distinguishing traces. Difference therefore functions as a joinable encounter topology rather than a rank ladder.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning makes the differentiation designed rather than accidental.
Turning something into a state supplies the move from common origin to organized plurality.
Branching separation gives peoples their divergent topology.
Mending a split keeps reunion live inside the same social root.
A group whose members face one another makes tribes encounter units, not sealed containers.
Recognition by trace or mark supplies the stated operation across differentiated groups.

changed_reading.before: Peoples and tribes are static inherited categories used simply for identification.
changed_reading.after: They are designed, branching social interfaces whose separation remains oriented toward repair, encounter, and reciprocal trace-based recognition.

baseline_models.mechanism: The packet maps الناس into a root field of visible human presence, perception, and familiarity that removes estrangement. Facing and reciprocal recognition then describe a process in which persons become perceptible and familiar to one another without ceasing to differ.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence frames humanity as appearing over against hiddenness or wildness.
Perceiving by sight, hearing, or sensation makes human presence an event of awareness.
Familiar comfort that removes estrangement gives recognition an affective outcome.
Mutual facing supplies the interpersonal geometry in which perception becomes reciprocal.
Mutual recognition converts perceptibility into social knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The address names an already constituted humanity and asks groups to learn one another's labels.
changed_reading.after: Humanity is enacted as visible presence becoming mutually perceptible; recognition converts estrangement into familiarity without erasing plurality.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إن أكرمكم عند الله أتقاكم إن الله عليم خبير
baseline_models.mechanism: The honor comparative remains active, including rivalry in nobility, but its tribunal is relocated to presence with God and its criterion to placing the self under protection. Knowledge and tested inward expertise make this rank resistant to lineage display and public self-certification.

activation_trace.role: Rivalry in generosity and nobility keeps competitive rank pressure visible rather than pretending it disappears.
Presence or nearness, including nearness in judgment and rank, relocates the tribunal to God.
Placing the self in protective moral caution supplies the replacement criterion.
Knowledge through disclosure prevents the criterion from depending on human guesswork.
Tested knowledge of inward reality distinguishes inner character from outward appearance.

changed_reading.before: Nobility is an observable social superlative attached to lineage and reputation.
changed_reading.after: The comparative is preserved but its evidence and tribunal are displaced: worth is protective self-governance assessed through divine knowledge of the interior.

baseline_models.mechanism: Human recognition works through traces, visible features, and distinguishing marks. The closing pair moves from disclosed knowledge to expertise in inward reality, setting a ceiling on what visible identity can prove: marks identify, but they do not adjudicate worth.

activation_trace.role: Recognition by a trace makes signs necessary to ordinary human knowing.
Visible features by which face or land is known specify the outward evidence available to people.
A distinguishing mark that points beyond itself casts group identity as an index.
Knowledge of the inner matter reserves final evaluation from surface marks.

changed_reading.before: Visible people-group markers both identify a person and disclose that person's value.
changed_reading.after: Markers support mutual recognition but remain only indexes; the verse closes by denying their competence to reveal inward worth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خلقناكم من ذكر وأنثى ... إن أكرمكم ... أتقاكم
baseline_models.mechanism: Male and female occupy the shared generative source before peoples and tribes are made into social forms. Neither sex branch supplies the predicate of honor; that predicate is separately attached to guarded conduct, blocking sex and descent from becoming implicit honor scales.

activation_trace.role: Male as counterpart to female supplies one coordinate of the common source pair.
Female as counterpart to male completes the common source pair without a rank predicate.
Bringing into being places the pair at the level of shared human origin.
Turning into social states distinguishes later organization from generative origin.
Praiseworthy nobility supplies the value term only after the source and social categories.
Protective moral self-placement alone fills the stated criterion of comparative honor.

changed_reading.before: Male/female and peoples/tribes can be read as parallel natural ladders of rank.
changed_reading.after: The sex pair names shared generation and peoples/tribes name subsequent organization; only guarded conduct is grammatically installed as an honor criterion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening prohibition on advancing, followed by self-protection, turns the God-side honor metric into a procedural restraint: people may not submit their own rank ledger in advance of the tribunal named in the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Competitive nobility supplies the rank impulse that seeks to get ahead.
Presence in divine judgment locates the authoritative ranking site.
Advancing forward and taking precedence gives the prohibited procedural move.
Putting the self in protection replaces premature assertion with restraint.

structural_cues: 49:1 places non-advancement before God and messenger immediately before the command to practice self-protection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies precedence, prohibition, divine position, and protection; I infer that premature social ranking is one form of advancing a judgment. A live alternative is that 49:1 governs only command etiquette, while the rank implication remains analogical.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah merely substitutes piety for lineage in an otherwise humanly administered ranking system.
changed_reading.after: It also suspends human priority-setting itself: the God-side criterion cannot be safely converted into a preemptive social ledger.

context_deltas.mechanism: Raised voice and being above create an acoustic image of self-elevation; lowered sound is then joined to a test that exposes the heart for protection. Honor can therefore be inversely related to public signal strength: restraint may reveal what display obscures.

activation_trace.role: Rivalry in nobility supplies the social pressure toward audible self-elevation.
Protective self-restraint is the focus criterion whose audible form is being tested.
Voice-raising makes status display physically audible.
Elevation in rank or excellence lets acoustic height activate social height.
Withholding and lowering by reduction supplies the counter-movement to display.
A test that reveals what is in the heart converts quietness into diagnostic evidence.
The pure core locates the tested quality beneath the public sound.
Repeated self-protection explicitly names the end for which the hearts are tested.

structural_cues: 49:2 warns that loud elevation can void deeds without awareness; 49:3 answers with lowered voices, tested hearts, and protection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vertical sound, lowering, a revealing test, the heart-core, and protection; I map acoustic verticality onto status signaling. The narrower alternative is etiquette toward the messenger with no general theory of low-signal honor.

changed_reading.before: The most honored should be publicly legible through a stronger reputation and more forceful presence.
changed_reading.after: The context makes restrained signal a possible evidence of honor and loud self-elevation a mechanism that can destroy the very deeds used to claim it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calling across a concealed enclosure tries to force presence on demand. Patiently restraining oneself until the other emerges turns reciprocal recognition into threshold ethics: encounter requires allowing the other a boundary and a time of appearance.

activation_trace.role: Familiarity that removes estrangement supplies the desired social outcome.
Mutual facing makes genuine encounter depend on both sides becoming available.
Recognition remains the focus operation altered by the threshold sequence.
Raised calling supplies the attempt to compel attention from outside.
Concealment behind visibility supplies the inaccessible side of the encounter.
Prevention and enclosure make the chamber an active social boundary.
Holding the self back supplies respect for another's timing.
Emergence to the outside completes encounter without forced access.

structural_cues: 49:4-5 reverses impatient calling from behind an enclosure into waiting until voluntary emergence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calling, concealment, enclosure, self-restraint, and emergence; I infer an ethical arrow from respecting thresholds to viable mutual recognition. The immediate alternative is only household etiquette around the chambers.

changed_reading.before: To know one another means maximizing access and making every person immediately available.
changed_reading.after: Recognition is bounded encounter: patience and respected thresholds let the other appear as a participant rather than an object summoned on demand.

context_deltas.mechanism: A delivered report must be made clear because an unmarked unknown can be mistaken for knowledge and injure a people, leaving regret. Mutual recognition is therefore not automatic familiarity; it is a fallible evidentiary practice that must test the traces by which groups are known.

activation_trace.role: Recognition by a trace supplies the focus process vulnerable to false evidence.
A distinguishing sign that points to something clarifies what verification must inspect.
An arriving, transmitted report supplies mediated evidence about another group.
Appearance and disclosure supply the work of making the report's reality clear.
The unknown without sign or tested experience names the epistemic failure behind injury.
Regret over what has passed supplies the irreversible cost of failed recognition.

structural_cues: 49:6 gives a causal sequence: report, clarification, harming a people in ignorance, then regret.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies report transmission, disclosure, an unmarked unknown, harm, and regret; I infer that the focus command to recognize carries an evidentiary duty. The alternative is a discrete news protocol that does not redefine recognition generally.

changed_reading.before: Any increase in information or contact counts as successful mutual recognition.
changed_reading.after: Recognition is disciplined trace-reading: unverified information can manufacture a false people-image and turn contact into collective injury.

context_deltas.mechanism: Seed-bearing love is made beautiful in the heart-core and named as gift and soft bounty. In contact with creation as inner disposition and honor as good growth, the criterion of protection becomes cultivated affective ecology rather than inherited essence.

activation_trace.role: Inner disposition and character supplies the human medium being formed.
Good growth and rain-bearing bounty gives honor a fertile rather than hereditary image.
Protective moral self-placement names the cultivated disposition's operative form.
A seed that sprouts and bears fruit supplies the latent growth mechanism.
Love adhering to the heart translates the seed image into affective attachment.
Making something beautiful supplies attraction toward the cultivated good.
The pure core locates cultivation beneath social appearance.
Gift and benefaction prevent cultivated honor from becoming self-authored pedigree.
Softness and flourishing ease extend the growth ecology as bounty.

structural_cues: 49:7 places love, adornment, and aversion inside hearts; 49:8 attributes the resulting condition to divine favor and gift.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seed, love, adornment, heart-core, gift, and soft bounty; I infer a cultivation sequence from latent seed to moral orientation. A live alternative keeps these as separate affective metaphors without an ecological mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The most guarded possess a fixed moral quality comparable to inherited status.
changed_reading.after: Guarded honor can be read as a cultivated interior ecology whose loves and aversions grow through gift, making pedigree an especially poor proxy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root for peoples already holds both branching and mending. Conflict activates both poles: separated groups are made to return, estrangement is removed, balance is imposed, and brotherhood is rebound. Plurality is thus a repair obligation with political procedures, not merely a diversity fact.

activation_trace.role: Branching separation supplies the possibility of social fracture.
Mending a split supplies repair as an equally live potential within peoplehood.
A mutually facing group makes each collective accountable to another collective.
Removing estrangement between people gives the explicit repair operation.
Return and turning back supplies the reversible movement out of aggression.
Justice in judgment and conduct constrains how the split is repaired.
A straight balance gives repair a measurable symmetry rather than sentimental reunion.
A fastening bond renders brotherhood as something that can be actively secured.

structural_cues: 49:9 repeats repair before and after coerced return and then specifies justice; 49:10 restates the parties as siblings and repeats repair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies split/mend, return, removal of estrangement, balance, and fastening; I infer that created group difference generates institutions of repair. The alternative is that these conflict rules concern believers only and do not characterize peoples and tribes generally.

changed_reading.before: Peoples and tribes are benign categories whose purpose is exhausted by acquaintance.
changed_reading.after: Their branching makes fracture predictable, so their purpose includes equitable repair, return from aggression, and renewed bonds across still-distinct groups.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same visible mark that enables recognition can be converted into a name-sign used for mockery and defect-finding. The command not to wound your own selves folds the target back into the speaker's social body, so weaponized classification defeats the reciprocal purpose of group distinction.

activation_trace.role: Recognition by trace supplies the legitimate use of social distinction.
Visible identifying features make clear how recognition can attach to outward marks.
Mockery and laughter at another supplies the conversion of difference into status injury.
The non-dominant mapped image of a visible mark that makes a thing known turns naming into social marking.
Marking out a defect supplies the hostile reading imposed on the visible sign.
The self or thing itself makes injury to another rebound as injury within a shared identity.

structural_cues: 49:11 parallels one people-group against another and women against women before prohibiting defect-finding and hostile naming.
Packet roots ن ب ز at 49:11[27] and ل ق ب at 49:11[28] lack branch inventories and are used only as structural evidence for weaponized labels.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recognition marks, mockery, visible naming marks, defect-finding, and self-reference; I infer a reversible path from index to stigma. The alternative treats each prohibition as independent manners rather than a failure mode of classification.

changed_reading.before: Names and group markers are neutral tools that automatically serve mutual recognition.
changed_reading.after: Markers are ethically unstable: they can orient encounter or be weaponized into stigmas that injure the shared self and reinstall forbidden rank.

context_deltas.mechanism: Suspicion manufactures an interior from weak signs, spying covertly extracts it, and backbiting circulates a person while absent. Against divine expertise in inward reality, human mutual recognition is bounded and reciprocal; it is not permission to penetrate hidden interiors unilaterally.

activation_trace.role: Mutual recognition by available traces supplies the legitimate epistemic relation.
Tested knowledge of inward reality marks the depth of knowledge attributed to God.
Bad suspicion about people supplies an imagined interior imposed without reciprocal disclosure.
Secretly tracking reports supplies unilateral extraction of hidden information.
Speaking of a person in absence converts the hidden person into circulating social material.

structural_cues: 49:12 sequences suspicion, covert investigation, and speech about an absent other before repeating self-protection and divine mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies imposed suspicion, covert report-tracking, absence, and divine inward expertise; I infer an asymmetry between reciprocal human recognition and divine penetration of interiors. The alternative is a list of separate privacy wrongs with no direct limit on لتعارفوا.

changed_reading.before: Knowing one another licenses progressively deeper collection of information about others.
changed_reading.after: Mutual recognition has a privacy boundary: covert extraction and speculative interior-reading imitate a depth of knowledge the focus closure reserves to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The people-root's mending and the tribe-root's joined parts meet a sequence of eating, flesh as woven kinship, brotherhood, and death. Backbiting becomes a social metabolism that consumes the connective tissue of plurality precisely when the absent member cannot answer, recognize, or help repair the breach.

activation_trace.role: Mending a split supplies the social integrity that destructive speech undoes.
Joined parts facing each other render a collective as assembled connective structure.
Literal taking of food supplies the consuming action in the ayah's material analogy.
Corruption and tale-bearing between people turns consumption into a social mechanism.
The weft of cloth makes flesh an image of connective tissue.
Kinship and allegiance make that connective tissue explicitly social.
Brotherhood identifies the consumed tissue as belonging to a relation, not an isolated body.
Loss of life removes reciprocal speech and resistance from the consumed member.

structural_cues: 49:12 renders backbiting as eating the flesh of an absent dead brother, placing relation, consumption, and non-response in one image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mending, joined parts, consumption, woven kinship, brotherhood, and death; I infer that hostile speech metabolizes the bonds required for recognition. The alternative is that the food image supplies disgust only, without a model of social tissue.

changed_reading.before: Backbiting is a private speech offense adjacent to the focus ayah's social categories.
changed_reading.after: It is a mechanism that consumes the relational tissue holding differentiated groups together and disables reciprocal recognition by exploiting absence.

context_deltas.mechanism: A named social population voices an identity claim, but settled trust has not yet entered the heart's core. This sharply separates externally recognizable category and utterance from inward state, strengthening the focus ayah's refusal to derive honor from group identity.

activation_trace.role: A visible distinguishing mark supplies the external category available to human recognition.
Knowledge of inward reality supplies the depth at which the claim is evaluated.
The Arabs and Bedouins supply the publicly named social category making the claim.
Assent in which the heart rests supplies the claimed state and its missing inward settlement.
Entry into an interior makes identity a process not completed by saying a label.
Interior and secret character specify the domain into which the claimed state must pass.
The pure core supplies the inward location unavailable to public group naming.

structural_cues: 49:14 directly corrects a spoken faith claim to submission and says faith has not yet entered the speakers' hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a social name, a verbal claim, settled trust, entry, and heart-core; I infer that recognizable identity can precede and misreport inward formation. The alternative is a one-time correction of these speakers with no general identity distinction.

changed_reading.before: A recognized group label and declared affiliation can function as evidence of the inward criterion of honor.
changed_reading.after: Social category and verbal affiliation remain exterior signs; the morally relevant state must enter and settle in the interior they cannot certify.

context_deltas.mechanism: Unsettled doubt is answered by effort under hardship through wealth and life, and truth becomes fulfillment in action. Human beings cannot inspect the heart directly, but costly deeds can serve as defeasible traces of the guarded interior, unlike costless lineage and labels.

activation_trace.role: Recognition by trace supplies the way inward claims become partially legible to others.
Divine inward expertise keeps action traces from becoming exhaustive human verdicts.
Disturbing doubt supplies the instability that action must answer.
Expending capacity under hardship makes the trace costly rather than merely declarative.
Acquired wealth supplies one expendable stake in the enacted claim.
The life-bearing self supplies the embodied stake beyond property.
Fulfilling word through deed converts truthfulness from assertion into performance.

structural_cues: 49:15 orders belief, absence of doubt, costly exertion with property and selves, then names the actors truthful.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies doubt, costly exertion, wealth, life, and performed truth; I infer that action is a defeasible outward trace of inward guarding. The live alternative is a definition of believers that does not authorize any social inference about honor.

changed_reading.before: Because God alone knows the interior, the honor criterion leaves no humanly available evidence at all.
changed_reading.after: Costly, truth-fulfilling action can witness to the interior without becoming a complete rank certificate; it contrasts with costless inherited signs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The challenge about informing God of religion is surrounded by comprehensive knowing. Human signs and declarations can point something out to other humans, but they add nothing to divine knowledge; therefore group identity cannot function as evidence submitted to improve God's honor judgment.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing sign that points to something defines the finite human function of identity markers.
Knowledge of inward reality already supplies what a declaration cannot add.
Repeated disclosure and knowledge frames the absurdity of trying to supply God with information.
A knowable, reportable thing extends the knowledge claim to every possible object of identity speech.
Obedience and submission supplies the religious state humans propose to announce.
Enclosure and totality makes divine knowledge comprehensive rather than piecemeal.

structural_cues: 49:16 opens by challenging people who would teach God their religion and closes with God's knowledge of every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human informing, religion, comprehensive knowledge, and reportable things; I infer that identity claims cannot act as evidence newly delivered to the divine tribunal. The alternative confines the rebuke to boastful speech without changing the epistemic status of group markers.

changed_reading.before: Religious or social self-description can present relevant new evidence for one's standing with God.
changed_reading.after: Such descriptions work horizontally as signs for people, but vertically they are informationally empty; the judge already knows the sign, deed, and interior.

context_deltas.mechanism: People convert submission into a favor that burdens its recipient and seeks social credit. The direction reverses: gentle guidance toward settled trust is God's gift to them. Competitive honor and gifts seeking recompense are thus exposed as a false economy of moral status.

activation_trace.role: Rivalry in nobility supplies the status competition driving the boast.
A gift offered in expectation of return supplies the transactional model of claimed submission.
Burdening a beneficiary by recalling a favor makes boastful submission into social debt.
Gentle direction toward the path reverses agency and locates the initiating gift with God.
Settled assent in the heart names the destination of guidance rather than a favor delivered upward.
Truth as fulfillment in action leaves the claim conditional rather than self-validating.

structural_cues: 49:17 repeats the human act of conferring favor, prohibits it, then assigns the favor to God for guidance toward faith.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies debt-producing benefaction, gentle guidance, settled trust, and enacted truth; I infer a reversal in the economy of honor from creditor status to received guidance. The alternative is only a correction of gratitude with no link to أكرمكم.

changed_reading.before: Religious affiliation can be offered as a contribution that earns honor and puts others, even the messenger, in one's debt.
changed_reading.after: Boasted affiliation reverses the real dependence: guidance is received rather than donated, so honor cannot be cashed out as moral credit over others.

context_deltas.mechanism: Humans appear and recognize one another through visible features, while the closure sees both what is hidden from eyes and deliberate action. The asymmetry preserves multiple kinds of legibility: people may read marks and deeds, but God alone joins unseen interior and fully seen action in judgment.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence supplies the ordinary field in which people encounter one another.
Visible features by which a face or land is known specify humanly readable identity.
Inward expertise supplies the focus claim that exceeds visible identification.
Knowledge through disclosure extends divine knowing across the closing claim.
What is concealed from eyes supplies the domain unavailable to ordinary recognition.
Ocular seeing grounds the explicit visibility of what people do.
Insight of the heart keeps divine seeing from being reduced to surface optics.
Intentional action supplies the observable trace joined to hidden knowledge.

structural_cues: 49:18 pairs knowledge of the unseen heavens and earth with sight of what people do.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible human features, hiddenness from eyes, ocular sight, inward insight, and intentional deeds; I infer layered rather than identical human and divine legibility. The alternative reads the final pair only as comprehensive omniscience without implications for social ranking.

changed_reading.before: Either honor is entirely visible in group identity and deeds, or it is wholly hidden and socially unintelligible.
changed_reading.after: The context permits partial human legibility through marks and action while reserving the joined reading of hidden interior and action to God.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The pupil image is a surprising branch activation, not a lexical replacement for الناس. It remains anchored by the focus sequence of visible humanity, face-to-face tribes, and reciprocal recognition, and by the closing sight cue; downstream prose should present it explicitly as an optical relational analogy.

activation_trace.role: The little human image seen in the pupil makes a person appear inside another's act of seeing.
Mutual facing provides the geometry for one person's image to enter another's eye.
Reciprocal recognition turns the optical image into a relational account of personhood.
Ocular sight reactivates the literal visual channel at the surah's close.

changed_reading.before: A human being is a self-contained bearer of a group identity who then observes others.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, personhood becomes reflexive: the human appears as an image in another's pupil, and mutual recognition is part of how each becomes socially visible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-material analogy built from branch images of a patched waterskin, opposed parts, woven flesh, and repair. It remains anchored to شعوبا وقبائل and the context's repair commands, but downstream prose should qualify the vessel as a model of social assembly, not an asserted etymology.

activation_trace.role: A waterskin joined from patches supplies a whole that exists through seams between pieces.
Parts joined while facing one another makes difference the structure of the seam.
Removing estrangement supplies maintenance when the social seam opens.
The weft of cloth reinforces the image of a whole made by connective crossings.

changed_reading.before: Social unity is imagined as homogeneity with differences added afterward.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, humanity is a sewn vessel: distinct pieces and the seams between them are what let the shared whole hold, carry, and sometimes leak.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The fertile-land branch under the female root is branch-distant and must not be rendered as an equation of women with soil. It remains live only as one component in a wider focus-anchored ecology of fertile honor, soft ground, cultivation, and earth; downstream prose should mark it as material activation and reject gender essentialism.

activation_trace.role: Easy fertile ground unexpectedly opens a generative terrain image at the source pair.
Good plant growth and rain-bearing bounty turns honor toward fruitfulness.
Soft low ground that gathers water supplies an inward terrain able to receive growth.
Working soft land through cultivation supplies active formation rather than fixed essence.
Soft productive earth broadens the terrain image beyond the gendered branch.

changed_reading.before: Honor is a fixed possession inhering in persons or lineages.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, honor is fertile inner terrain: receptive, watered, and cultivated toward good growth rather than inherited as a finished rank.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation depends on the form-distant non-dominant ه د د target carried under the context root ه د ي. It remains anchored by the focus ayah's male and honor terms and the context's dominant gentle-guidance branch, but downstream prose must call it a split-root counter-reading, not a lexical sense of هدى.

activation_trace.role: Hard, sharp, forceful masculinity supplies a possible cultural bundle of maleness and power.
Praiseworthy nobility and generosity supplies the honor term vulnerable to that bundle.
Rivalrous outdoing shows how the bundle could become competitive social force.
The non-dominant split image of strength and generosity in a man activates the bundled reading explicitly.
The dominant image of gentle direction toward truth supplies the counter-movement that unbundles honor from force.

changed_reading.before: Maleness, strength, generosity, and honor can travel as one mutually reinforcing status package.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the split activation exposes that package and then reverses it: valid honor depends on receiving gentle direction, not performing forceful masculinity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The poison image comes from a form-distant non-dominant س م م target under س م و and is not a lexical gloss for الاسم. It remains anchored by the context's sequence of mockery, defect-finding, and hostile naming and by the focus command of recognition; downstream prose should render it only as a contained image of how labels can enter and damage a social body.

activation_trace.role: Recognition by signs supplies the legitimate circulation of identity markers.
Mockery supplies the hostile social setting in which a marker becomes injurious.
A visible mark that makes something known supplies naming's identifying surface.
A poison entering the body supplies the surprising mechanism by which a hostile name penetrates beyond its surface.

changed_reading.before: A hostile label remains an external sound that can be ignored while recognition continues normally.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root image, a label can act like a penetrating carrier: the same sign that identifies can enter the social body and corrupt recognition from within.

strongest_changes: Created plurality changed from static taxonomy into a branch-and-repair topology with obligations of encounter, verification, and equitable restoration.
Mutual recognition became a bounded epistemic practice: visible marks and costly deeds are usable traces, while suspicion, surveillance, and hostile naming corrupt them.
Honor moved beyond replacing lineage with another public rank; context suspends premature ranking, tests quiet interiors, and reverses boastful moral credit into received guidance.
The focus closure now supports layered legibility: humans can recognize signs and action, but only divine knowledge joins those traces to the hidden interior.
summary.what_was_special: The trace retained both poles inside single roots, especially separation and mending, and allowed optical, sewn-vessel, cultivated-terrain, and split-root images to coexist with the stronger social and epistemic models rather than collapsing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: How far the non-dominant ه د ي to ه د د and س م و to س م م activations should travel beyond explicitly contained counter-readings.
Whether the optical, vessel, and fertile-terrain analogies should enter downstream prose or remain diagnostic latent activations.
How much costly action can function as a humanly readable trace without recreating the rank ledger that divine inward knowledge destabilizes.
